==Problem==

In how many ways can the letters in <imath>\textbf{BEEKEEPER}</imath> be rearranged so that two or more <imath>\textbf{E}</imath>s do not appear together?

<imath>\textbf{(A) } 1 \qquad \textbf{(B) } 4 \qquad \textbf{(C) } 12 \qquad \textbf{(D) } 24 \qquad \textbf{(E) } 120</imath>

==Solution==

All valid arrangements of the letters must be of the form <cmath>\textbf{E\underline{\hspace{3mm}}E\underline{\hspace{3mm}}E\underline{\hspace{3mm}}E\underline{\hspace{3mm}}E}.</cmath>
The problem is equivalent to counting the arrangements of <imath>\textbf{B},\textbf{K},\textbf{P},</imath> and <imath>\textbf{R}</imath> into the four blanks, in which there are <imath>4!=\boxed{\textbf{(D) } 24}</imath> ways.

~MRENTHUSIASM
